subtitle: How @ParameterName actually connects to a dataset query

caption: Each @Parameter maps to a report parameter's value on the Parameters tab.

code:
-- Single-value parameter
WHERE StoreID = (@StoreID)

-- Once the parameter allows
-- multiple values:
WHERE StoreID IN (@StoreID)
caption: IN tests for inclusion in a set — required once @StoreID is multi-value.
